+---
+## What
+
+marketplace.md §5.2 and §6.4. Read a marketplace catalog and resolve the list of skills. Keep this code independent of git: it reads files through a small protocol. A local folder implements the protocol now; the libgit2 tree reader implements it later.
+
+Create in `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Marketplace/`:
+- `CatalogFileSource.swift` — `protocol CatalogFileSource: Sendable` with `func contents(atPath: String) throws -> Data?` and `func entries(inDirectory: String) throws -> [CatalogTreeEntry]`. `CatalogTreeEntry` has `name` and `kind` (`.file(isExecutable: Bool)`, `.directory`, `.symlink(target: String)`, `.submodule`). Add `LocalCatalogFileSource(root: URL)`.
+- `MarketplaceCatalog.swift` — `Decodable` models for `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`: `name`, `owner`, `metadata.version`, `plugins[]` (`name`, `source` as a string or an object, `strict`, `skills: [String]?`), and `renames: [String: String?]`.
+- `CatalogResolver.swift` — `CatalogResolver.resolve(from: any CatalogFileSource, selection: SkillSelection?) -> ResolvedCatalog`. Order: `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, then `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`, then a scan (`skills/*/SKILL.md`, then a root `SKILL.md`, maximum depth 3; the shallower one wins). `ResolvedCatalog` has `name`, `version`, `skills: [ResolvedSkill(name, path, plugin)]`, `renames`, and `diagnostics: [MarketplaceDiagnostic]`.
+
+Rules:
+- For a plugin, use its `skills` array. If there is none, use `<plugin source>/skills/*/SKILL.md`.
+- A plugin with a remote `source` object (`github`, `git-subdir`, `url`) gets a diagnostic and is skipped.
+- A duplicate skill name inside one catalog gets a diagnostic; the later plugin wins.
+
+`SkillSelection` is defined by the "marketplace sources and identity" task. If that task is not merged yet, define `SkillSelection` here in `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Marketplace/SkillSelection.swift` (`.all`, `.plugins([String])`, `.skills([String])`) and let the other task reuse it.
+
+Put the fixtures in `Examples/marketplace-fixtures/catalogs/`, and find them from `#filePath` in the same way as `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/FixtureLibrary.swift`. The fixtures are: a copy of the `anthropics/skills` catalog, an excerpt of the Claude official catalog with `renames` and a `git-subdir` plugin, and a catalog in our own format.
+
+- [ ] `CatalogFileSource` and `LocalCatalogFileSource`
+- [ ] `MarketplaceCatalog` decoding, including a `source` given as a string or an object
+- [ ] `CatalogResolver`: order, plugin skills, scan fallback, duplicates
+- [ ] Selection filter and `renames` handling (rename → new name + diagnostic; `null` → removed + diagnostic)
+- [ ] Fixtures under `Examples/marketplace-fixtures/catalogs/`
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The resolver gives the correct skill list for all three fixture catalogs and for a catalog-free fixture folder
+- [ ] A remote plugin source, a duplicate, an unknown selected name, and a renamed name each give exactly one diagnostic and never throw
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/MarketplaceCatalogTests.swift`: golden tests for each fixture catalog; the Codex path; the scan fallback with depth and shallow-wins; `.plugins` and `.skills` selection; `renames`; a remote plugin source is skipped with a diagnostic
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter MarketplaceCatalogTests`; then `swift test`; all green
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #marketplace
